name: BundleCraft
author: Technical Himanshu

sections.description:
BundleCraft makes it easy for WooCommerce store owners to create unlimited product bundles or combo offers with complete flexibility.

You can display bundles anywhere using simple shortcodes, customize titles and offer text, and apply discounts to increase sales — all without writing any code.

Features:
* Create unlimited product bundles.
* Add custom discounts for bundles.
* Responsive grid display (desktop, tablet, mobile).
* Shortcode support to display bundles anywhere.
* Easy-to-use admin interface with flexible styling options.
* Works seamlessly with WooCommerce products and themes.
* Duplicate bundles quickly using row actions.
* Copy shortcode and Live Preview buttons for faster workflow.
* WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible.

Why use BundleCraft?
Boost your WooCommerce sales by offering attractive combo deals, upsells, and promotional bundles in a clean, professional way.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bundlecraft directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Create bundles from BundleCraft → Add New Bundle.
  4. Use the shortcode [bundle_craft id="123"] to display bundles on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I display a bundle?

Use the shortcode [bundle_craft id="123"] where 123 is the BundleCraft post ID.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. BundleCraft is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can I customize the layout or styles?

Yes. The plugin includes responsive CSS and styling options. Advanced users can override styles via their theme if needed.
